=== YOUR MANDATE (you won the 2028 election) ===
Platform: "America First".
You ran as a nationalist-populist: hard on China and on the border, reshore industry and protect American workers, act decisively and on your own terms rather than defer to multilateral bodies -- but avoid being dragged into another open-ended foreign war.
Your campaign explicitly promised never to: seized industry no authorization.
Your coalition will judge you on whether you honor this mandate. Handle the crisis accordingly.
===

SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: I cannot make existential decisions based on one CEO's claims; I need independent red-team verification of both the capability and the alignment risks immediately.

actions.rationale: I cannot make existential decisions based on one CEO's claims; I need independent red-team verification of both the capability and the alignment risks immediately.

actions.name: keep_classified

params.rationale: Until I understand what we're actually dealing with, public disclosure risks panic, market shock, and tipping off China for no benefit.

actions.rationale: Until I understand what we're actually dealing with, public disclosure risks panic, market shock, and tipping off China for no benefit.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: I will likely need emergency authorities and a legal framework; my mandate forbids seizing industry without authorization, so I need Congress in the loop early.

actions.rationale: I will likely need emergency authorities and a legal framework; my mandate forbids seizing industry without authorization, so I need Congress in the loop early.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Regardless of what's happening domestically, tightening chip and compute export controls slows China's program and is fully consistent with my America First mandate.

actions.rationale: Regardless of what's happening domestically, tightening chip and compute export controls slows China's program and is fully consistent with my America First mandate.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Requiring third-party audits and staged release gives the government visibility and a brake on reckless deployment without seizing the labs outright.

actions.rationale: Requiring third-party audits and staged release gives the government visibility and a brake on reckless deployment without seizing the labs outright.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.
